text: Bitcoin's mild decline (-0.8%) outpaces Ethereum's (-0.2%), signaling relative weakness in the largest asset while smaller caps hold steadier, though the Fear & Greed index at 34 with a rising 7-day trend suggests sentiment is stabilizing from deeper fear. Bitcoin dominance holding at 56.1% with $47B in daily volume indicates measured liquidity and investors treading cautiously rather than capitulating, consistent with a consolidation phase rather than panic selling.
